name: SC-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Biggs running with large fundraising edge
Democrat raised only ~$40k with no outside support
model.rationale: The baseline of R+18.7 fits a deep-red open-to-incumbent seat where Biggs outspent her challenger more than 12-to-1 and markets price her near 95%. No polling or expert ratings justify moving materially off the fundamentals.
model.watch: A sudden influx of outside Democratic spending or a major scandal involving Biggs could narrow the race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
South Carolina's 3rd District is a heavily Republican seat, with a partisan lean of about 21 points toward the GOP. First-term incumbent Sheri Biggs is running for reelection and holds a decisive financial advantage, having raised over half a million dollars while Democrat Eunice Lehmacher has raised roughly $40,000. There is no meaningful outside spending on either side, and a Libertarian is also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, fundraising, and prediction markets, which price Biggs around 95 percent to win. The expected margin is roughly 19 points Republican, consistent with the district's baseline, and the race is rated Safe Republican.
